scientific.integrity: Exact algebraic proof with strict coefficient positivity and a standalone standard-library exact-rational test. No stochastic-limit or experimental data claim.
scientific.limitations: Only deterministic scalar autonomous mean-field infection and endemic equilibrium stability; no finite stochastic absorbing-process persistence or arbitrary-order hydrodynamic theorem. Root-prescription theorem requires sum of roots at most one half.
scientific.object: Homogeneous deterministic scalar higher-order SIS prevalence equation on a fully connected simplicial complex

title: Sharp interaction-order threshold for arbitrarily many attracting endemic prevalences
